finalText: Last night's deploy failed because migration 0042 timed out (ruled out OOM, a bad env var, and a stale docker cache along the way; also noticed two flaky tests, unrelated to this failure). The timeout happened because events.user_id has no index in prod — the index exists in staging, but prod never got it since migration 0041 was manually marked as applied back in 2024. No code changes were made this session.
